summary: A dashboard page shell with four KPI cards and a placeholder card for a chart or table.
use: The base page layout of a dashboard: title, headline metrics and a main content area.
spec: `<PageShell title="Dashboard">` is the root, with no description or actions
`<KpiGrid>` holds 4 `KpiCard` items: Revenue `$118k`, Users `24.8k`, Growth `34%`, Uptime `99.9%`
Each card has a `trend` and an `icon`, for example `trend={23.4} icon={DollarSign}`
`<Card full>` holds the text Chart or data table goes here
